title: Повторение с карута

Keep its thick rounded dark forest-green contours, cute proportions, simple flat matte colors. Japanese character is conveyed by the specified props, not a costume change. Whole cat and specified props visible in a compact centered square scene with generous transparent safe margins. Exactly two forepaws, two hindpaws, one tail.
